name: humanizer
description: Write, edit and review English and Brazilian Portuguese text without AI-writing patterns, keeping facts, meaning and the author's voice.

interface.shortDescription: Edit English and Portuguese text so it reads like a person wrote it.
interface.longDescription: Rewrites or reviews text in English or Brazilian Portuguese against a catalog of 50 AI-writing patterns drawn from the Wikipedia guides and published research. Keeps facts, meaning, technical terms and degree of certainty, and can match a sample of your own writing.
defaultPrompt: Use $humanizer to rewrite this text without changing its facts.
Use $humanizer to point out the AI-writing patterns in this text without rewriting it.
